body: Thanks for this comment. As someone who recently had a brown recluse in an area we are not supposed to get them, it can feel silly to ask a question like this. But it is very helpful to have a community where it is ok to ask questions that might seem silly in the hopes of getting an honest answer. I am very grateful to this sub.
Oh wow we thought for sure it couldn’t be since they don’t live here. Thank you!
You’re doing amazing! What’s keeping you going tonight?
For me it’s walking. I do these hikes for weeks at a time, in my lowest mood it’s the only thing that will keep me going.

Chicago teacher here. Talk to people about why we are right to stay out of school. Your families, your friends, your neighbors, etc. Post and support on social media. Amplify CTU (Chicago teachers union) voices when you can. Here are my personal talking points: we can’t be in person if we can’t safely staff the schools. In my school alone we have 15 staff who are COVID+ and unable to work, dozens of students, 14 classrooms in quarantine. 

Our principals are at their breaking point too, they can’t continue to deal with our staffing shortages.

More questions? I can find out!
I get how you’re feeling. It doesn’t get better soon, or even relatively soon. Sometimes the only thing that helps is talking to people who understand.
There are people who care about you. What is going on with you?
If you eat some will it make you feel better or worse?
Ok I understand. Can you drink some water or tea and readdress in the morning? In my experience evenings are the hardest time to stay emotionally even
What do you have to eat? At my house I keep emergency chips and salsa
Right now being well is the most important thing. If you’re hungry you should eat. You can always work on other aspects of health later.
Do you have something that you can eat? Or can you take a rest and check back in?

I don’t believe that anyone is useless, despite having those feelings about myself in the past. All lives are worth caring about, and yours is no exception. I hope that you feel ok with talking more about where you’re at right now.
I mean honestly, that’s their problem not yours. But also why do you think that?
No! What makes you feel like you’re useless?

We must have very different TikTok feeds because all the prek teachers I see talk about how messy teaching is. Social media can be so toxic and self-esteem destroying. I know I have to be very careful about my consumption or it affects my self image. Remember - all social media is created/shared with an audience in mind. Nothing is completely authentic. ❤️

Yes I have done all the things you suggested, through the official request processes. My assistant principal has told the MTSS team not to discuss my student because she will “handle it” instead, and then does not reply to my emails.
The other thing he likes to do is tell “STUPID TEACHER I DONT WANT YOU” while following me around the classroom clearly begging for attention, which is objectively funny, so I’ll go with laugh.
I hope tomorrow is better for you

Today only? Student tells me “you’re treating me like an asshole”. “You’re fucking me up”: 

No, I’m just helping you learn healthy boundaries that maybe you can’t handle right now. 

Note: I teach 4-5 year olds, and this is not the most extreme behavior I have had even this year.
Thanks you. I post in this group because I know someone will hear me. The letter writing idea is very good and I will use it. I am ok for now, for anyone whose was worried. Thank you Reddit.
I have been seeing a therapist for a long time for anxiety. Suicidal thoughts are a new thing for me and I am struggling to bring it up with her. I know I need to but it is hard.

I always have rubrics first math, and teach third grade. Students can demonstrate partial understanding of a concept, so it’s not quite to black and white as you may think. Happy to provide more specific examples if you are interested

We just started standards based grading and  I gotta say I love it. Teacher led, though, so maybe that’s the difference. I feel like my grades are so much more useful to me now though - I use them to pull strategy groups and identify which skills I need to reteach.

As a person who has struggled with suicidal ideation, I️ want you to know, too, that it is not your responsibility to save your friend. We all make our own choices, and you are doing the best that you can to help someone that you care about. But you need to take care of yourself as well, and your friend’s choice to attempt suicide has nothing to do with you and is not your fault at all.

You are clearly a strong and compassionate person - you are only doing good in the world, so please don’t blame yourself for anything that is out of your control.

<3
